judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format the dataset; it does not describe this spiral/color-word MEG dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: iEEG-BIDS is a data-organization specification (BIDS extension); this dataset is MEG/EEG color-spiral data, so the paper is a standard, not its data paper.
judgments.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
